Executive Summary & System Evolution Report II

Phase 1 Baseline (Prototype)
Client-Only Architecture
Initial milestone focused strictly on client-side React 19 canvas rendering and in-memory presentation schemas with local state persistence.
Generic Placeholder Images
Early visual previews relied on static CSS watermarks or arbitrary mock placeholders without external content correlation.
Manual Slide Authoring
Required users to write content bullet-by-bullet or use mock templates without live generative artificial intelligence capabilities.
No User Persistence or Cloud State
Decks were isolated to single browser instances with zero authentication or multi-device cloud synchronization.
Phase 2–4 Transformation (Production Full-Stack)
Production Express & MongoDB Atlas Backend
Full RESTful micro-service with BCrypt password hashing, stateless JSON Web Tokens (JWT), and MongoDB Atlas cloud storage.
Google Gemini 3 Flash Prompt Engineering
Sub-2 second structured JSON inference generating 15-25 word factual bullets (**Key Concept:**) with zero marketing fluff.
Concurrent Unsplash HD Visual Pipeline
Automated contextual photo matching with parallel fetching, photographer attribution badges, and 42% split layout image cards.
Phase 4 Present Mode & 5 Streamlined Exports
Fullscreen presentation engine with keyboard controls, auto-hiding HUD, and strictly focused 5 production export formats.

End-to-End System Architecture Data Flow

Vercel React SPA

Landing, Auth, Studio Dashboard, 16:9 Editor, and Present Mode.

➔

Render Express API

JWT verification, input validation, and asynchronous microservice coordination.

➔

Google Gemini 3

Structured schema synthesis with domain bullets & image query keywords.

➔

Unsplash API

Concurrent parallel image retrieval for each generated slide topic.

➔

MongoDB Atlas

Atomic persistence of authenticated deck state and slide arrays.

Stateless Microservice Design

Decoupled frontend and backend communicating exclusively over HTTPS with JWT bearer authentication. Frontend assets cache on Vercel's global CDN while the Express backend executes on Render container infrastructure.

Dual Engine Parallel Synthesis

Generative text synthesis and visual asset discovery occur in a synchronized multi-stage pipeline: Gemini produces topic-aligned image search keywords, which trigger concurrent Unsplash queries via Promise.all.

Generative AI & Image Pipeline Workflow Pipeline

01 INPUT
Prompt & Count
User specifies deck topic and slide count (3 to 15) in the Studio Dashboard AI Modal.
02 LLM
Gemini Synthesis
Gemini 3 Flash returns strictly typed JSON with 15-25 word factual bullets and landscape query tags.
03 PARALLEL
Unsplash Pipeline
Backend executes concurrent Unsplash searches via Promise.all, securing high-res photography and credits.
04 PERSIST
Atlas Database Save
Complete presentation with integrated images and layout metadata commits atomically to MongoDB.
05 RENDER
16:9 Canvas Display
React mounts the presentation immediately into the editor with 42% image cards and present mode triggers.
⚡ Prompt Engineering Rule: Gemini is strictly prompted to prohibit marketing buzzwords and produce 15–25 word factual bullets formatted as **Key Concept:** Description with real-world metrics.

Database Models & Authentication Security Data Schema

User Model & JWT Authentication
• name: String (Trimmed, 2–50 characters)
Author profile identity displayed on studio dashboard and export metadata.
• email: String (Unique index, normalized lowercase)
Primary authentication credential preventing duplicate registration conflicts.
• password: String (BCrypt Salted Hash)
Pre-save Mongoose hook runs bcrypt.genSalt(10) ensuring raw passwords never touch disk.
• JWT Session Management
Issues HMAC-SHA256 signed bearer tokens with 7-day expiration and automatic 401 redirect protection.
Project & Slide Schema Hierarchy
• userId: ObjectId (Indexed foreign key)
Strict tenant isolation ensuring users only access and modify their own presentation decks.
• slides: [SlideSubdocument]
Sequential collection containing slide id, title, subtitle, layout, and content array.
• image: { url, alt, photographerName, photographerUrl }
Embedded object linking high-res Unsplash photo asset and required API attribution badges.
• timestamps: { createdAt, updatedAt }
Automated change tracking facilitating dashboard recency sorting and audit histories.

JWT User Authentication & Security Showcase 2

Figure 2: Secure sign-in dialog with validation feedback (/login) Backend JWT Authentication

Security Architecture

  • Stateless Token Auth: Client stores signed JWT bearer token securely in browser storage.
  • Automatic Route Guard: <ProtectedRoute> wrapper instantly redirects unauthenticated users to /login.
  • Input Normalization: Trimmed strings and lowercased email sanitization prevent case sensitivity bugs.
  • BCrypt Hashing: Passwords protected with industry-standard adaptive salted hashes on Render backend.
  • One-Click Switching: Seamless navigation between Login and Signup modals with unified error messaging.

Streamlined 5-Format Export Engine Showcase 7

Figure 7: Streamlined export modal restricted strictly to 5 production formats Client-Side Document Compilers

5 Production Formats

  • 1. PDF Document: Multi-page landscape PDF compiled at 2x High-DPI resolution via jsPDF and html2canvas.

  • 4. Microsoft Word (.docx): Structured document generated using client-side docx Packer.
  • 5. PowerPoint Deck (.pptx): Native widescreen 16:9 slides built via pptxgenjs for offline PowerPoint editing.

Engineering Challenges Faced & Solved Problem Solving

Technical Hurdle Architectural Solution Implemented
Google Gemini Model Deprecation (gemini-2.0-flash 404) Migrated to gemini-3-flash-preview with responseMimeType: 'application/json', reducing generation latency from ~90s down to ~1.9s.
Sequential Image Fetching Bottlenecked Deck Creation Engineered a parallel Promise.all Unsplash pipeline executing all slide image queries concurrently without blocking Express event loop.
Washed-out / Invisible Slide Images Overhauled SlideRenderer.jsx to render true <img> elements inside prominent 42% split layout cards with dark hero backdrops.
GitHub Secret Scanning Blocked Git Push Reset repository tree, updated render.yaml with sync: false for all secrets, and enforced strict .gitignore rules.
Render Free Tier Cold Start & URL Normalization Implemented defensive URL trimming in src/utils/api.js guaranteeing accurate routing regardless of trailing slash or missing /api.
Vercel SPA Client-Side Direct Routing 404s Configured vercel.json rewrites routing all dynamic paths back to /index.html, preserving React Router state on reload.
